findings.evidence: RadialTwist.lean:229-233 `have hsq : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ ‖w - p‖ ^ 2) (𝓝 p) (𝓝 0) := ... simpa using this.tendsto p` matches the new `hsq` exactly; RadialTwist.lean:243-246 matches the new `hψ'` term.
findings.fix: Generalise those two lemmas the way `hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian` was generalised, taking `H` plus `hH : ∀ y, ‖y - p‖ < ρ → H =ᶠ[𝓝 y] radialHamiltonian G p`, and prove them from `hamiltonianFlow_eq_of_forall_eventuallyEq_radialHamiltonian`. Or compare ψ near `p i` with the single-twist flow (`htwist` + `hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian` on `ball (p i) (r/2)`) and apply `hasFDerivAt_hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_center ... |>.congr_of_eventuallyEq`.
findings.issue: `hsq`/`hnear`/`hψ'` copy the proofs of `hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_eventuallyEq` (RadialTwist.lean:223, same `hsq` block verbatim) and `hasFDerivAt_hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_center` (RadialTwist.lean:237, same `((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) _).sub_const _).const_mul _ |>.const_add _` term).

findings.evidence: RadialTwist.lean:257-262: `have h : p + exp (...) * (w - p) - w = (exp (...) - 1) * (w - p) := by ring; rw [h, norm_mul]; gcongr; exact Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le` matches the new `hsub`/`calc` block.
findings.fix: State `norm_hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_sub_le` for any `H` meeting the circle hypothesis of `hamiltonianFlow_eq_of_forall_eventuallyEq_radialHamiltonian` (the radial case then follows with `fun _ _ ↦ .rfl`), and use it here with the `hw` hypothesis already fed to `htwist`.
findings.issue: The displacement branch (`hsub` by `ring`, `norm_mul`, `gcongr`, `Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le`) re-proves `norm_hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_sub_le` (RadialTwist.lean:250-262) for the sum Hamiltonian.

summary: The finite-family theorem and the new locality and sum-of-twists lemmas are new material, but the main proof re-derives the existing single-twist rotation, derivative-at-centre and displacement lemmas line for line instead of reusing them.
